notes: Read the complete target and context. Quote the proper name Our Revolution. Preserve where-relevant, may-choose, national-priority and long-term-goal qualifications; do not turn chapter discretion into a national endorsement or a forecast into a commitment.

claims.claim_text: Support, where relevant, for DSA chapters to work with post-Sanders groups such as "Our Revolution", its local variants and Brand New Congress to expand anti-corporate electoral politics.
Support for DSA chapters to build strong electoral coalitions with progressive groups rooted in communities of color and feminist, LGBTQIA+ and disability movements.
Only genuinely multiracial electoral coalitions can build working-class political power.
There will be mass mobilization in 2018 to defeat Republican rule at state and national levels, especially among constituencies vulnerable to far-right nativist, racist and anti-labor politics.
Support for allowing DSA chapters to choose to back progressive, anti-corporate candidates who do not openly identify as socialists.
Commitment for concrete national DSA electoral support to prioritize chapters backing openly socialist candidates.
Building a mass socialist political formation in the United States is DSA's long-term objective.

Support for national DSA to prioritize cultivating and supporting socialist candidates accountable to its political agenda who can support increasingly assertive and widespread independent socialist electoral activity.
Cultivating accountable socialist candidates will be critical to developing an alternative to the neoliberal third-way politics of the Democratic Party's corporate establishment.
